description: This file defines API routes for managing recipes in a FastAPI application, including endpoints for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting recipes. It utilizes dependencies for database sessions and user authentication, and interacts with service functions and schemas related to recipes.

methods.name: RecipePublic create_recipe_endpoint( payload: RecipeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new recipe associated with the current user using the provided recipe data.

methods.name: RecipePublic get_recipe_endpoint(recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Fetches a recipe by its ID from the database and returns it.

methods.name: dict list_recipes_endpoint( limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of recipes, including total count and items.

methods.name: RecipePublic update_recipe_endpoint( recipe_id: int, payload: RecipeUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates an existing recipe if owned by the current user.

methods.name: None delete_recipe_endpoint( recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a recipe if owned by the current user.
